description.value: The Norm Theatre is a cinema venue operated by the Alma Mater Society (AMS) at UBC's Student Nest on the University of British Columbia campus. As an AMS venue, it serves the UBC student community and sits within a large multi-use building that also houses food, services, and student resources. Touring cyclists passing through the UBC campus area will find it conveniently located along the university's well-developed cycling network.

address.value: 6133 University Blvd, UBC Campus, Vancouver, BC V6T 1Z1

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces, covered) at 41m; stands (20 spaces, covered) at 69m. Total: 30 spaces.
wow_evidence: AMS student cinema in the Nest — modest, event-conditional.
blurb: Student-run cinema in UBC's Nest building.
